arcs.title: The Corridor That Is Not Quite Level
arcs.summary: Day 1: Pemwick, on leave following the Biscuit Tin Endgame, has discovered during an ostensibly recreational corridor walk that the Ministry's east corridor is measurably unlevel — seventeen measurements logged, preliminary sketch completed. He has not yet named the file. The Ministry has not yet noticed he is investigating their building. Don's portrait has already weighed in on the technique. Day 2 should have Pemwick quietly expanding his survey to a second corridor or room, and someone in the Ministry beginning to notice that a man with a measuring tape has been in the building for two days on leave.
